build_siamese_model_helper: build a SiameseModelHelper instance with a model and split to construct ResNet-based siamese networks
add_shortcut_bottleneck: add a type B shortcut connection with conv and batch norm for dimension mismatch in residual blocks
create_conv_bn_block: create a convolution followed by spatial batch normalization layer with MSRA weight initialization
build_bottleneck_block: build a three-branch bottleneck residual block with conv-bn-relu layers and shortcut connection for ResNet
stack_residual_layer: stack multiple bottleneck blocks into a residual layer with configurable stride and block count
